newsitem.title: UK: Shell refinery has technical problem, may last 1 w.
newsitem.headline: Shell refinery has technical problem, may last 1 w.

text.p: Shell's 370,000 barrels per day (bpd) Rotterdam refinery has an unspecified technical problem that may last about one week, trade sources said.
A spokesman for the refinery was not able to comment immediately.
Trade sources said there was a technical problem at the refinery but could not give details about the impact on production of oil products or consumption of crude oil.
One source familiar with the refinery operations said the problem may last a week but was unable to give details of which units at the refinery might be effected.

Traders in the rotterdam heavy fuel market said the company had bought high sulphur barges at around $98 to $99 a tonne during the afternoon compared to levels of nearer $92 and $93 which traded during the morning.
"There must be something wrong at the refinery. They wouldn't simply buy at that level for no reason," said a trader.
